project.title: Aquascape pilot — stone, wood and two identified plants
project.description: First aquarium scenery material and 3D placement experiment. Produce a concept reference and an albedo atlas, then build reusable stone, branching driftwood, Anubias barteri var. nana and Microsorum pteropus meshes in a standalone Godot review scene alongside unchanged existing fish.
project.art_direction: Detailed naturalistic pixel art matching the supplied silver arowana: restrained colors, crisp fine pixel clusters, carefully painted surfaces. Cool gray stone, muted ochre brown wood, olive and forest green leaves. No glossy plastic, photographic PBR, large flat polygon fills or blurred airbrush.
project.gameplay_loop: Inspect aquarium scenery from multiple angles and compare texture mapping with gray and checker modes.
project.session_goal: A reviewable isolated 3D scenery pilot with concept, production atlas, mapping tests, final scene and species names; no gameplay or existing fish asset changes.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1440x900). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: aquascape_concept
asset.description: CONCEPT REFERENCE, not a runtime texture. Draw a single aquarium-bottom diorama on a quiet deep teal backdrop: asymmetric group of three irregular cool gray layered stones at left, old forked brown driftwood reaching diagonally right, small attached Anubias barteri var. nana at front with compact broad oval dark-green leaves and exposed horizontal rhizome; taller Microsorum pteropus behind the wood with long simple undivided lanceolate slightly rippled green leaves arising individually from a creeping rhizome. Fine warm sandy gravel ground, plenty of open swimming space above. Three-quarter view. The supplied fish image is ONLY the pixel-art style reference, do not draw fish or scales on the scenery. Naturalistic crisp detailed pixel clusters, matching the fish illustration. No aquarium glass, pots, text, labels, UI, photorealism, smooth CGI or glossy plastic. Distinct plant leaf shapes must be readable. This concept defines the scenery pilot only.

Silhouette: Readable masses: heavy stone stack left, thin diagonal wood line to right, low front Anubias clump, tall fern blades behind; large empty teal space above for gameplay.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Naturalistic detailed pixel art matching reference fish: restrained cool gray, muted ochre brown, olive and forest green palette; crisp fine pixel clusters, hand-painted surface grain, subtle dark contour edges, matte finish.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Three-quarter view from slightly above the substrate, seen from the tank front
